units.source_text: 吟时不胜依恋之情，而神态生动，甚可怜爱。

en.t: As she recited, she could not restrain her feelings of attachment, and her expression was so vivid and lively that she seemed deeply endearing.

units.source_text: 源氏吟唱古歌：“若非来此地……”，以安慰玉鬘。

en.t: Genji recited an old poem, beginning, "Had I not come to this place...", in order to comfort Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 他觉得此人越发可爱了。

en.t: He felt that she had become lovelier than ever.
The anguish of longing love was almost impossible to bear.
